howItWorks.title: How it Works
howItWorks.intro: Discover, plan, and share luxury travel — all in one intelligent platform.
howItWorks.headline: How Goldsainte AI Brings Your Trip to Life
howItWorks.description: Goldsainte transforms your travel ideas into a structured storyboard, then intelligently matches it within our curated marketplace of expert agents and creators. They compete to design and price your journey — while our AI streamlines the process from inspiration to booking.

step1.title: Share your inspiration
step1.body: Paste TikToks, Reels, mood images or notes. Tell us who's traveling, when, and the feeling you want the trip to hold.

step2.title: We craft your storyboard
step2.body: Our AI concierge translates your inspiration into a visual storyboard with destinations, hotel vibes and curated experiences that match your aesthetic.

step3.title: Creators and agents collaborate
step3.body: Matched creators refine the look and feel; certified travel agents layer in flights, stays and experiences — all inside the same evolving storyboard.

step4.title: You review, chat and book on Goldsainte
step4.body: Compare proposals, refine details in chat, and confirm the one that feels right. Payments go through Goldsainte's escrow for added protection.

howItWorks.paragraph1: Goldsainte blends AI technology with human expertise to make luxury travel effortless. Start by chatting with your personal concierge or saying "Hey Goldsainte." It learns your style — where you love to stay, dine, and explore — refining recommendations with every conversation.
howItWorks.paragraph2: Discover CoCurated™ collections designed by trusted creators and certified agents. Save your favorites, follow tastemakers who inspire you, and let our AI weave everything into itineraries that feel tailor-made.
howItWorks.paragraph3: Ready to plan? Post your trip and let expert agents bid to design your journey. Compare proposals, chat in real time, and choose the perfect fit — all with transparent pricing and milestone payments for peace of mind.
howItWorks.paragraph4: Book instantly through Goldsainte — flights, hotels, dining, and more — with secure checkout and automatic itinerary creation. Then, connect, share, and earn by becoming a creator yourself. Curate destinations, inspire travelers, and make money when others book from your recommendations.
howItWorks.paragraph5: Everything happens in one elegant platform — AI-driven, creator-powered, and designed for those who travel well.
howItWorks.subtitle: Luxury travel, reinvented.

founderLetter.title: Letter from the Founder
founderLetter.p1: When Goldsainte first launched, people asked how we were different from other travel services. The answer was simple: we combined trust, technology and taste in a way the industry had stopped doing. Today, we've grown far beyond those roots.
founderLetter.p2: Goldsainte is now a global luxury travel marketplace — where travelers, certified travel agents and modern creators meet to design extraordinary trips together.
founderLetter.p3: We believe travel is more than logistics. It's about creating experiences worth sharing, building real relationships with the specialists who design them, and giving creators a credible way to turn inspiration into bookable journeys.
founderLetter.p4: Our platform pairs AI-powered matching with verified human expertise. Travelers post a trip request and receive tailored proposals from certified agents and creators. Agents win new clients and get paid securely through escrow. Everything happens on-platform, protected end-to-end. This is only the beginning. Travel's best trips shouldn't be locked away in specialists' heads — we're building the place where they all live. Our ambition is simple to say and enormous to do: make Goldsainte the definitive home of specialist-crafted travel, worldwide.
founderLetter.p5: Thank you for being part of this journey. The best adventures are still ahead.

whatIs.title: What is Goldsainte?
whatIs.p1: Goldsainte is a luxury travel marketplace that connects three audiences: high-intent travelers, certified travel agents and modern travel creators. Post a trip request to receive tailored proposals from verified specialists, or book ready-made packaged trips directly. AI handles the matching; people design the trips.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: At Goldsainte, we believe travel is more than booking a flight or reserving a hotel — it's about creating unforgettable experiences, building meaningful relationships with the specialists who design them, and sharing journeys in ways that inspire others.
mission.p2: Our mission is to rebuild the modern travel marketplace around trust, taste and technology — pairing AI-powered matching with verified travel agents and creators worldwide, so every traveler gets a trip designed for them and every specialist gets paid fairly.
mission.p3: Whether you're a traveler planning a once-in-a-lifetime trip, a creator turning your audience into bookings, or a certified agent looking for a serious commercial home, Goldsainte gives you the tools, protections and community to thrive.
mission.p4: Behind the scenes, our AI matches briefs to the right specialists, structures proposals into clear bookable contracts, and keeps payments safe in escrow — releasing funds as each milestone of your trip is delivered.
mission.p5: Ultimately, we're building a travel ecosystem where technology enhances human expertise, where creators and agents are valued and rewarded, and where every journey becomes a story worth sharing.

partners.title: Our Partners & Technology
partners.description: Goldsainte is built on industry-leading infrastructure — OpenAI for AI matching and trip intelligence, Stripe for escrow payments, Connect payouts and identity verification, and a modern cloud backend for messaging, storage and real-time collaboration.

legal.title: Legal
legal.p1: Goldsainte Inc. (the company behind Goldsainte™) is registered and based in Delaware, United States ("Goldsainte", "we", "our"), from where it provides its AI-powered luxury travel and booking platform (the "Service") on its website (the "Website"), and is supported internationally by its affiliated companies (the "Support Companies"). The Support Companies provide only internal and operational support. They do not provide the Service and do not own, operate, or manage the Website or any other website.
legal.p2: For any questions regarding Goldsainte, the Service, or the Website, or to send or serve documents, notices, correspondence, or other communications, including press inquiries, please contact Goldsainte Inc. directly at its registered office in Delaware.
legal.p3: Goldsainte Inc. does not maintain a legal domicile at any other location or office, including the offices of its Support Companies. The Support Companies are not authorized to act as process agent or service agent for Goldsainte Inc., and no reservations can be made through the Support Companies.
